content:
mike-support: Heads-up: ACME asked for evidence for a recent CVE hit (CVE-2026-31415) that shows our patch prioritization rationale, SBOM, and KMS rotation proof. Auditor needs timeline + expiry of any mitigations. They want it within 3 business days.

anna-devsec: ack. can you paste the customer's exact ask / auditor email? need scopes (hosted vs dedicated vs private).

mike-support: pasted from auditor: "Provide SBOM for runtime+deps, mitigation/patch plan for CVE-2026-31415 (transitive in lib-crypto v3.2), evidence of KMS key rotation policy and last rotation for keys used to encrypt inference logs, and prioritization rationale/ticket links."

ben-runtime: quick note — runtime only uses lib-crypto indirectly via proto-serializer in private deployments. Hosted instances run a patched variant (we rolled CVE fix in 2026-02-10). Dedicated customers may be on older pinned images.

lina-prodops: timeline: hosted patched 2026-02-10 (image v2026.02.10), dedicated patch rollout started 2026-02-20 with canary, still 12 customers pending. private deployments: we provide patch guidance only.

anna-devsec: ok. we should produce: 1) SBOM snippet (component list + checksums) 2) patch evidence (release notes, image digests) 3) KMS rotation proof (audit log extract) 4) prioritization statement (risk assessment + customer impact)

ryan-devex: i'll assemble a one-page evidence bundle + short FAQ for CS to send. want me to include a sample command for verifying docker image digest?

mike-support: yes please. auditor also asked whether we use HSM for key material in Private.

legal-ops: for auditor sharing, redact customer-specific IDs and ensure we include only org-level KMS audit logs (no plaintext keys). use the standard attestation template.

ben-runtime: i can produce the release notes and image digests. digest example to include:

```
sha256:3f2a9c5b6e9c8f4d7a1d5e6f9b8c7a4f2e1d9c3b6a7f8e9c0d1b2a3c4d5e6f7  redwood/runtime:v2026.02.10
```

anna-devsec: KMS audit example (redacted):

```
2026-02-05T14:22:30Z  ACTION=RotateKey  KEY_ID=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/inference/cryptoKeys/inf-01  USER=ops-key-rotator@redwood
```

anna-devsec: that demonstrates rotation event. we should add our rotation policy (90 days for host keys, 180 days for backup keys) and the policy doc link.

lina-prodops: for dedicated customers still on older images, propose ETA to patch them: schedule bulk patch for next maintenance window (2026-03-02 to 2026-03-04). can we mark high-priority?

ben-runtime: yes mark as P0 for CVE score 8.1. tickets: RD-3742 (hosted fix), RD-3891 (dedicated rollout), RD-3910 (private guidance). include links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RD-3891

mike-support: customer wants exact ETA per tenant for dedicated mode. lina, can you export per-tenant schedule and share?

lina-prodops: on it. will export and redact internal notes. sending CSV to mike directly (not in thread).

legal-ops: also include signed attestation that we performed vulnerability triage and that no customer data was exposed as a result. follow SOC2 evidence checklist item 3.4.

ryan-devex: draft evidence bundle plan:
- SBOM pdf (generated from sbom tool, includes checksums)
- Release notes + image digest txt
- KMS rotation audit snippet + policy link
- Patch prioritization memo (one paragraph + ticket links)
- Per-tenant scheduled patch dates (for dedicated customers)
- Attestation pdf signed by security manager

anna-devsec: sounds good. i'll add the triage notes: root cause (transitive lib-crypto via proto-serializer), exploitability low in hosted because of patched runtime, but higher risk for pinned dedicated images. include mitigation: image pinning guidance and auto-update recommendation.

mike-support: auditor asked whether logs showing attempts/exploits exist. do we have IDS alerts?

sre-bot: correlation report: no confirmed exploit attempts targeting CVE-2026-31415 in the last 6 months across hosted clusters. (summary id: cr-2026-03-01-11)

ben-runtime: we should include that report PDF. also include the test harness that validated the patch: unit tests + fuzz run summary, short snippet: 

```
Fuzz summary: 2M inputs, 0 crashes, 0 undefined behaviors
Unit: proto-serializer tests: all green
```

anna-devsec: final question: do we include private deployment remediation scripts? yes, include guidance and example commands (not keys). e.g.

```
# update package
apt-get update && apt-get install --only-upgrade lib-crypto
# restart runtime
systemctl restart redwood-runtime
```

lina-prodops: i'll attach the maintenance window plan and confirmation of tenants opted out of auto-update.

mike-support: timeline to complete bundle?

ryan-devex: i can produce first draft by EOD tomorrow (2026-03-04). final signed bundle with attestation by 2026-03-06 if approvals on triage memo are quick.

legal-ops: confirm we won't disclose cryptographic material or raw logs. once bundle ready, route to legal for redaction check before sending.

anna-devsec: I'll approve the triage memo by 2026-03-05 morning.

mike-support: thanks team. i'll update the customer: first bundle (SBOM + release notes + KMS rotation snippet + triage memo draft) by 2026-03-05 COB.

ryan-devex: noted. attaching checklist to the ticket RD-4002.

mike-support: closing loop here, ping if any blocker. :thumbsup:
